claims_verified.claim: Lisa Demuth received 67 votes; Melissa Hortman received 65 votes; Demuth was declared duly elected Speaker.
The Agreement for House Organization and Temporary Rules were introduced for ratification.
The temporary-rules and organization resolution was adopted 130 yeas to 2 nays.

limitation: The repository contains this receipt and claim map but not the PDF binary; independent refetch-and-hash against the official URI remains desirable.
